amounts.context: Average cost of replacing a salaried employee

classification.rationale: A research brief with an objective, method, findings, recommendations and limitations.

summarization.headline: Remote-work eligibility is associated with 27% lower voluntary turnover among Crestline's salaried staff.
key_points: Study of 1,240 salaried employees across 14 sites over 18 months.
Results are observational: association, not causation.
summarization.title: Research Brief: Remote Work and Employee Retention
key_findings: Two or more remote days per week linked to 27% lower voluntary turnover
Effect strongest for employees with under three years of tenure
Replacing a salaried employee costs about $38,000
recommendations: Extend two-day remote eligibility to all suitable salaried roles
